<a id="start_sound_request"></a>
### [`start_sound_request`](../../../../src/music/requests.asm#L6) `$9E05`

*routine*

Starts the tune that sound_request,x asks for on voice X. When sound is off, drops requests of $83 and higher.

- **Called from:** [`music_tick`](tick.md#music_tick)
- **Reads:** [`sound_request`](../../memory-map.md#sound_request), [`sound_off`](../../memory-map.md#sound_off), [`voice_sid_offsets`](driver_tables.md#voice_sid_offsets), [`sid_shadow_control`](../../memory-map.md#sid_shadow_control), [`sid_shadow_res_filt`](../../memory-map.md#sid_shadow_res_filt), [`bit_masks_inverted`](../data/bit_masks.md#bit_masks_inverted)
- **Writes:** [`sound_request`](../../memory-map.md#sound_request), [`voice_tune`](../../memory-map.md#voice_tune), [`filter_speed`](../../memory-map.md#filter_speed), [`effect_flags`](../../memory-map.md#effect_flags), [`note_time`](../../memory-map.md#note_time), [`note_time_hi`](../../memory-map.md#note_time_hi), [`voice_data_offset`](../../memory-map.md#voice_data_offset), [`voice_data_offset_hi`](../../memory-map.md#voice_data_offset_hi), [`sid_shadow_control`](../../memory-map.md#sid_shadow_control), [`sid_shadow_res_filt`](../../memory-map.md#sid_shadow_res_filt)

### [`update_volume_fade`](../../../../src/music/requests.asm#L39) `$9E46`

*routine*
